import dataclasses
from typing import Any

import pytest

from llm_router._internal.runtime.errors import AttemptLeftError

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@dataclasses.dataclass
class _LeftFlag:
    is_set_val: bool = True

    def is_set(self) -> bool:
        return self.is_set_val


class _DummyAdapter:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.called = False

    def execute(self, request: Any) -> Any:
        self.called = True
        return None


def _check_left(flag: _LeftFlag) -> None:
    if flag.is_set():
        raise AttemptLeftError()


class _AttemptAdapterWrapper:
    def __init__(self, adapter: _DummyAdapter, left: _LeftFlag) -> None:
        self.adapter = adapter
        self.left = left

    def execute(self, request: Any) -> Any:
        _check_left(self.left)
        return self.adapter.execute(request)


@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_TIMED_OUT_ATTEMPT_STOPS[revision==1]")
def test_timed_out_left_attempt_stops_further_provider_request() -> None:
    underlying = _DummyAdapter()
    flag = _LeftFlag(is_set_val=True)
    wrapped = _AttemptAdapterWrapper(underlying, flag)
    with pytest.raises(AttemptLeftError, match=r""):
        wrapped.execute("test-request")
    assert not underlying.called
